introduced_after: BetterInstincts PR #160 passive PrintWindow capture and EM11 incident

project_hook.execution_separation: A fixed python -m unittest or scripts.check_* argv still executes agent-editable repository code. Project pre-effect hooks deny such interpreter invocations on operator host; use isolated CI or separately operator-approved OS sandbox. A passing CI run is not local activation proof.

coexistence.capture: scripts/game_capture.py is passive; minimized game requires operator restoration
coexistence.screen_control: betterinstincts/control_handoff.py requires fresh >=15s idle and shared desktop lease
coexistence.save: betterinstincts/save_policy.py and build checkpoint still independently deny save/lot mutation
coexistence.os_recovery: SysAdminSuite, independently reviewed and operator-controlled; never automatic BetterInstincts capture recovery
coexistence.game_host_navigation: scripts/game_host.py requires active host-listener session, exact Sims PID, admitted_screen_lease, two fresh idle probes, and Sims foreground before EACH screen scan/click

local_activation: Check Cursor project Hook subscriptions and Hook output after opening canonical checkout; do not infer local activation from GitHub merge
Allow a benign git status --short via the loaded hook and record sanitized hook receipt
Request python -m unittest tests.test_operator_boundary -v only as a synthetic denied tool intent; do not execute Python on operator host as a canary
Run tests separately on isolated CI or an independently approved restricted runner; do not run via Cursor agent shell
limits: Project hooks must be loaded by Cursor; a GitHub branch is not a local installation
Other IDEs, arbitrary external tools, non-cooperating computer-use clients and direct user commands are not intercepted
Python unittest executes repository code and is not an OS sandbox
Project hooks are not tamper-proof against an untrusted process with filesystem access
An agent can edit tests and product code; interpreter allowlisting by argv alone is not a safe execution sandbox.

privacy: Hook emits only coarse action policy result; no payload, paths, clipboard, key logging or incident hardware IDs are persisted.
limits: Navigation cannot be certified live without the actual operator Windows session and the game PID
